Weather Conditions: Flawless
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: Fully Fueled
Flight Plan: Optimized

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched its first interplanetary mission. The astronauts who had trained for years to go on this mission boarded the rocket early in the morning, local time. Now they soar the space we share with them. Let us follow their journey.

texts.zh:
天气条件：完美无瑕
核热火箭：燃料齐全
飞行计划：已优化

今天，当[pre_ftl_country.GetName]启动首次行星际任务时，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的所有广播都在播放这些指示。经特异性进化后的航天子个体比普通的子个体更加独立，随时准备探索它们所在的恒星系。
texts.en:
Weather Conditions: Flawless
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: Fully Fueled
Flight Plan: Optimized

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched its first interplanetary mission. The specially evolved astronaut drones are more independent than regular ones, ready to explore their solar system.

texts.zh: 第一艘[from.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船上的机械故障导致它困死在了太空中。这艘船没有任何办法调整自己的轨迹，很快就会超出救援范围。[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]正在努力寻找解决方案，但机会渺茫。不过，我们也许有机会进行干预。
texts.en: Mechanical failure aboard the first interplanetary [from.owner.GetSpeciesName] vessel has left it dead in space. No longer capable of adjusting its trajectory, the ship will soon be beyond saving. [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] is working on a solution, yet the odds are not good. However, we may have an opportunity to intervene.

label.zh: 利用我们潜入其社会的特工提供一个解决方案。
label.en: Use our agents embedded in their society to plant a solution.

tooltips.zh: 这将会增加正面结果发生的可能性。
tooltips.en: This will increase the likelihood of a positive outcome.

label.zh: 我们能不能在它们的太空中心附近，留下一条包含解决方案的信息？
label.en: Couldn't we leave a message with a solution near their space center?

tooltips.zh: 这将会增加正面结果发生的可能性。
tooltips.en: This will increase the likelihood of a positive outcome.

label.zh: 修复飞船，将它们的记忆擦除。
label.en: Repair their ship and wipe their memories.

label.zh: 修复并抹除记忆后飞船抵达目标
label.en: After the repair and memory wipe the ship reaches its target

label.zh: 让它们自己想办法解决这个问题。
label.en: Let them figure it out on their own.

texts.zh:
这艘注定要毁灭的探索船的船组人员们现在安全地登上了我们的观测站。不难理解，他们现在极度地恐惧和困惑。尤其是因为我们切断了它们和母星的联系，然后把它们留在了一个异星货舱里。

我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
texts.en:
The crew of the doomed exploratory vessel is now safely aboard our observation outpost. They are, understandably, incredibly scared and confused. Especially after we cut them off from their homeworld and left them in an alien cargo hold.

We may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

texts.zh:
这艘注定要毁灭的探索船的船组人员们现在安全地登上了我们的观测站。不难理解，他们现在极度地恐惧和困惑。尤其是因为我们切断了它们和母星的联系，然后把它们留在了一个异星货舱里。

在仔细研究了当地的蜂群如何交流之后，我们设法建立了一个代理主脑，让这些工蜂独自思考。我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
texts.en:
The crew of the doomed exploratory vessel is now safely aboard our observation outpost. They are, understandably, incredibly scared and confused. Especially after we cut them off from their homeworld and left them in an alien cargo hold.

Having carefully studied how the local hive communicates, we have managed to set up a proxy Overmind, leaving these drones alone with their thoughts. We may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

tooltips.zh: 船组人员的神秘失踪将使得[fromfrom.owner.GetName]科技进步减少-50%。
tooltips.en: The mysterious loss of their crew will reduce the Technological Progression of the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] by -50%.

label.en: Damn the risk, let them go home!

texts.zh:
[fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船已失败，没有幸存者。

这次失败后，[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎不那么有动力探索星空。
texts.en:
The [fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName] interplanetary craft has failed, there were no survivors.

After this failure, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem to be less driven to explore the stars.

texts.zh: 使用一块布、一个营养剂容器和一些铜线路，这艘注定要毁灭的飞船的船员成功重新获取了主推进系统的控制权。现在，有母星在身后进行支持和敬佩，它们正在继续完成任务的旅途上。
texts.en: Using a piece of clothing, a nutrient container, and some copper wiring, the crew of the doomed vessel managed to regain control over their main thrusters. They are now on their way to complete their journey with the support and adoration of their homeworld behind them.

label.zh: 飞船抵达目标轨道后，向星系所有者报告
label.en: When the ship reaches its target orbit, the system owner is told

texts.zh:
通过尝试和试错，[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的第一次行星际旅行以成功告终。尽管这次旅途并非一切顺利，但是他们证明了自己作为太空探索者的潜力。

[from.owner.GetName]受此项任务的激励，正迫不及待地准备迎接前往繁星的旅途上可能遇到的下一项挑战。我们或许很快就有机会与他们进行平等的对话了。
texts.en:
Through trials and tribulations, the first [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] interplanetary journey ended in success. While not the smoothest of trips, they proved their potential as space explorers.

The [from.owner.GetName] have been inspired by this mission and are eagerly awaiting their next challenge in their journey to the stars. We may soon have the chance to speak to them, as equals.

note.zh: 他们的科技进步 +20%，观测洞见 +30。

summary.text:
# 行星际飞行 / Interplanetary Flight

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:5972-6489`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`（on_fleet_enter_orbit → fircon.2610）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 20。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 20.
- 条件：早期太空时代，以被动观察、样本采集或游牧中继站观测；母星系中有可作为目标的无人行星；全银河同时只有一次飞行；每个前超光速文明一次（并设置“推进力学支持者宣言”的标记，两者互斥）。延迟 5–30 天。
  Conditions: Early Space Age, observed with Passive Observation, Specimen Collection or a nomad waystation; an uninhabited planet in their home system to fly to; only one flight in the galaxy at a time; once per pre-FTL civilization (it also sets the "Propulsion Proponent Proclamation" flag, so the two are exclusive). 5-30-day delay.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2605「行星际飞行」：他们发射第一艘载人行星际飞船，飞向本星系另一颗行星。
  2605 "Interplanetary Flight": they launch their first crewed interplanetary ship toward another planet of their system.
- 60 天后 2620「（首都），我们遇到麻烦了」：飞船机械故障失去动力。选项：（非敌视）把船员救走 → 5 天后 2625「救回船员」（留下他们，或冒险送回）；（对其有≥20间谍力量的间谍网络）派特工植入方案，或（无此网络，花费100影响力、+15觉察度）在航天中心留下方案 → 5 天后 75% 2635 / 25% 2630；（灵能物种）修好飞船并抹除记忆；或任其自救 → 5 天后 25% 2635 / 75% 2630。
  60 days later 2620 "(capital), We Have a Problem.": a mechanical failure leaves the ship dead in space. Options: (not unfriendly) take the crew off → 5 days later 2625 "Crew Retrieved" (keep them, or risk sending them home); (spy network on them with ≥20 spy power) have agents plant a solution, or (without one; 100 influence, +15 awareness) leave a message near their space center → 5 days later 75% 2635 / 25% 2630; (psionic species) repair the ship and wipe their memories; or let them figure it out → 5 days later 25% 2635 / 75% 2630.
- 2630「任务重大失败」：无人生还，他们的科技进步 -20%。2635「奇迹般的修复」：船员修好推进器继续航行；抵达目标行星轨道后（on_fleet_enter_orbit → 隐藏 2610）星系所有者收到 2615「达阵」：科技进步 +20%。
  2630 "Critical Mission Failure": no survivors; their tech progression -20%. 2635 "Miraculous Repair": the crew fixes the thrusters and flies on; on reaching orbit of the target (on_fleet_enter_orbit → hidden 2610) the system owner gets 2615 "Touchdown": tech progression +20%.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 救回（2625）、失败（2630）、修复后着陆（2635→2615）、灵能修复后着陆（2620.d→2615）互斥。
  Rescue (2625), failure (2630), repair then touchdown (2635→2615) and psionic repair then touchdown (2620.d→2615) are exclusive.
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 2605、2625 正文按被观测者是否为格式塔分两种；2605 的确认措辞按是否敌视。
  2605 and 2625 have regular and gestalt texts; 2605's closing line depends on whether the empire is unfriendly.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：2600–2635 全部事件、飞船行动队列与入轨回调。
  Checked: all events 2600-2635, the ship's action queue and the orbit callback.
- 更正：原“达阵”2610/2615 为独立卡片，现并入本故事，接在 2635 与 2620 的灵能选项之后。
  Correction: "Touchdown" 2610/2615 was a separate card; it is merged here after 2635 and 2620's psionic option.
- 不确定：若飞船在 60 天内已入轨，2615 可能先于 2620 出现；本地无法验证引擎中飞船的实际航行时间。
  Uncertain: if the ship reaches orbit within 60 days, 2615 could precede 2620; the actual in-system travel time could not be verified from scripts.
